faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

whatIsMorkBorg.a: MÖRK BORG is a doom metal album of a game. A rules-light, art-heavy tabletop RPG about lost souls seeking redemption in a bleak world. The game is published by Free League Publishing.

whatIsScvmGrinder.a: Scvm Rack is a free character sheet and generator for MÖRK BORG. It helps you create characters, track stats, and manage equipment during your games.

isItFree.a: Yes! Scvm Rack is completely free to use. You can create and save characters without paying anything.

guestVsAccount.a: No account needed to start. As a guest, you get one character — generating a new one replaces it. Characters are kept for 7 days. Sign up (free) to keep unlimited characters permanently, accessible from any device.

howToSave.q: How do I save my character?
howToSave.a: Characters save automatically as you edit. As a guest, your single character is stored for 7 days. Sign up to keep it permanently and create more.

multipleCharacters.a: With an account, yes — create and switch between as many characters as you like from the Scvms menu. As a guest, you get exactly one. Generating a new scvm replaces the current one.

mobileSupport.a: Yes! Scvm Rack is designed to work on phones, tablets, and desktops. Use it at the table or on the go.

offlineUse.a: Currently, Scvm Rack requires an internet connection. Offline support may be added in the future.

bugReport.q: I found a bug! How do I report it?
bugReport.a: Please report bugs via GitHub issues or contact us directly. We appreciate your help making Scvm Rack better!

howCanIHelp.a: You can support the project on Buy Me a Coffee: https://ko-fi.com/tackgnols_rpgtools. Every contribution helps keeping the rack alive!

faq.morkBorgCredit: MÖRK BORG is © Free League Publishing. This is an independent fan project.

privacy.title: BLOOD OATH
privacy.subtitle: Data, Tracking, and Storage Notice

sections.storage: Browser storage is required for core operation. We store technical and gameplay data on your device, including language settings, session flags, active character references, and privacy preferences.
sections.backend: Character and gameplay content that you enter in this app is transmitted to and stored on our backend services, including guest sessions. This storage occurs even if you do not create an account.
sections.analytics: If analytics is enabled below, Google Analytics is used to process usage events and page activity. You can disable analytics at any time without losing core app functionality.
sections.sensitiveData: Do not enter sensitive personal data in character fields. By continuing to use this app, you acknowledge and accept this notice.
